name: 赐福
description: 所有友方棋子下一次造成伤害时，伤害增加4点。
code: function executeSkill(context) { const sourcePiece = context.piece; const battle = context.battle; const allies = battle.pieces.filter(function(p) { return p.ownerPlayerId === sourcePiece.ownerPlayerId && p.currentHp > 0; }); allies.forEach(function(ally) { applyEffect(ally.instanceId, 'effect-divine-blessing', { currentUses: 1, intensity: 4 }); }); return { message: sourcePiece.name + '为所有友方棋子赐福，下一次伤害增加4点', success: true }; }
previewCode: function calculatePreview(piece, skillDef) { return { description: '所有友方棋子下一次造成伤害时，伤害增加4点。', expectedValues: { damageBonus: 4 } }; }
